description: This file implements the TransportConnectSubJob class, which manages network socket connection attempts, including lock acquisition, connection establishment, and handling WebSocket endpoint locks within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamSocket
classes.description: A wrapper around StreamSocket that manages registration with WebSocketEndpointLockManager on creation and destruction, forwarding socket operations.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates the connection process, starting with lock acquisition.

methods.name: GotEndpointLock
methods.description: Callback invoked when WebSocket endpoint lock is acquired.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the connection attempt.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous IO operations.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing connection states and transitions.

methods.name: DoEndpointLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire WebSocket endpoint lock if applicable.

methods.name: DoEndpointLockComplete
methods.description: Completes lock acquisition and initiates socket connection.

methods.name: DoTransportConnectComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of socket connection attempt, manages retries or success.
